city.Luxembourg.description: Luxembourg is a small country in western Europe, bordered by France, Germany and Belgium. It's the world's only Grand Duchy, ruled by a Grand Duke, with an old fortress city full of tunnels and free public transport for everyone.
city.Luxembourg.landmark: fortified old city of Luxembourg on its cliffs above the Alzette river and the Grund quarter
city.Luxembourg.flag: studied a flag in a guidebook: three stripes, red on top, white in the middle, light blue at the bottom
city.Luxembourg.clue.0: planned a train trip to a tiny country in western Europe, hugged by France, Germany and Belgium
city.Luxembourg.clue.1: kept talking about the world's only country ruled by a Grand Duke, from a real palace
city.Luxembourg.clue.2: loved that all the buses and trains there are completely free to ride
city.Malta.description: This tiny island country sits in the sunny Mediterranean Sea between Italy and North Africa. It is famous for honey-colored stone towns, ancient temples older than the pyramids, and clear blue harbors full of boats.
city.Malta.landmark: golden limestone bastions and domes of Valletta above the blue Grand Harbour with colorful boats
city.Malta.greeting: In Maltese, hello is “Bonġu” (BON-joo), used to wish someone a good morning.
city.Malta.flag: half white and half red with a little grey cross in the top corner
city.Malta.clue.0: circled a sunny little island right in the middle of the Mediterranean Sea, between Italy and Africa
city.Malta.clue.1: wanted to walk through ancient stone temples said to be older than the Egyptian pyramids
city.Moldova.description: This small, landlocked country in Eastern Europe sits between Romania and Ukraine. It is famous for rolling vineyards, a wine cellar so huge its tunnels stretch for miles, and a monastery carved into a river cliff.
city.Moldova.landmark: cave monastery of Orheiul Vechi on a green cliff above a looping river
city.Moldova.greeting: Most people speak Romanian — say hello with “Bună” (BOO-nuh).
city.Moldova.flag: traced a flag: blue, yellow and red stripes with an eagle holding a shield in the middle
city.Moldova.clue.0: kept talking about heading to a small, landlocked country wedged between Romania and Ukraine
city.Moldova.clue.1: wanted to explore an enormous underground cellar with tunnels holding millions of bottles
city.Montenegro.description: This small country on Europe's Adriatic coast is named “Black Mountain” for the dark peaks that rise straight from the sea, above old stone towns and a deep, winding bay.
city.Montenegro.landmark: old walled town of Kotor on its fjord-like bay ringed by dark mountains
city.Montenegro.flag: red with a golden border and a golden two-headed eagle
city.Montenegro.clue.0: asked about buses to a small country in Europe, right beside the sea
city.Montenegro.clue.1: said the country's very name means “Black Mountain,” for its dark peaks by the water
city.North Macedonia.description: This small, landlocked country in the Balkans of southern Europe is known for ancient Lake Ohrid, its capital Skopje crowded with statues, and green mountains dotted with old stone churches.
city.North Macedonia.landmark: little Church of St. John at Kaneo on a cliff above the deep blue Lake Ohrid
city.North Macedonia.flag: drew a flag: bright red with a golden sun in the center shooting out wide rays
city.North Macedonia.clue.0: packed for a small, landlocked mountain country in the Balkans, just north of Greece
